description: GOC (Pak) Limited is a Sialkot-based sports goods manufacturer, incorporated in 1964 as a Pakistani-British joint venture with H.J. Gray & Sons of Cambridge, England. It has made hockey sticks since 1965 — including the U-shaped 'novelty' head developed with Dutch technical know-how — and added a hand-sewn cricket ball unit in 1973 producing under the Duke & Sons and Gray-Nicolls brands. Output runs at more than 160,000 hockey sticks and around 100,000 cricket balls a year, sold through a network of marketing agents at home and abroad.
